An admin pastes a wrong username, the server returns success_json, the member list reloads without the user, and there is no error anywhere — the admin cannot tell why nothing happened; the group.save error path can never fire because group attributes were never modified.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, usernames are split and each is looked up via `User.find_by_username`; nonexistent usernames are simply skipped (`if user = ...; group.add(user); end`). The action then unconditionally attempts `group.save` and returns `success_json` on true, even when no users were added (e.g., all usernames were typos), so the client will see “success” with no feedback. The `render_json_error` branch isn’t strictly impossible (save could fail due to validations/db), but given no attributes are changed and the group is already valid, it’s effectively unreachable for the “all usernames invalid” case. This is a real, diff-grounded UX/edge-case concern rather than a clear correctness break.
